script: One Japanese engineer once survived both atomic bombs, in Hiroshima and Nagasaki, three days apart.

title: One Man Survived Both Atomic Bombs in 1945
description:
Tsutomu Yamaguchi survived the atomic bombing of Hiroshima, then traveled home to Nagasaki just in time for the second bomb three days later. He lived until 2010.

Did you know this actually happened? Let me know in the comments.
